# Step - date_add

`date_add` · `dateAdd` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

Adds n DT units or a duration, optionally in a zone whose IANA name the result keeps (TinkerPop dateAdd()).

## Forms

```text
date_add(arg1: duration)
date_add(arg1: DT, arg2: i64)
date_add(arg1: duration, arg2: string)
date_add(arg1: DT, arg2: i64, arg3: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(date("2024-01-31")).date_add(DT.month, 1).next().day   // 29
```
